chapter: After Basie: Cafe Society to Los Angeles
title: Leaving Basie when the band wanted Lena Horne
summary: Dance moves to the Basie recordings, then asks whether Basie tried to keep her. Humes says the band was trying to get Lena Horne, so she left.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: One thing we will do before we finish about Basie, we'll just talk about some of those record albums, those record sessions that you made because - in fact, I think we'll just have a look at them right now.

Alright, we've come back to the records that you made with Basie, and we have a little bit more information on those sessions. So right now, well you made up your mind that you had just about enough of the road with Basie, is that it?
Did Basie try to get you to stay?
Well, they was trying to get Lena Horne.
Oh, really? To play with the Band. Williard Alexander, yeah. So you just left?
